states.summary: Paid PMPM increased by $20.13 (+31.2%) consistently across the period.

drivers.title: What's Driving the Change
description: The change is primarily driven by Cost — Admit Impact: $-0.73 PMPM, Cost per Admit Impact: $20.86 PMPM.
Cost per Admit breakdown: ALOS Impact: $7.74 PMPM, CMI Impact: $-0.65 PMPM, CMI-adj Cost per Day Impact: $13.76 PMPM.

drivers.title: What Services are Driving It
description: The change is concentrated in Other O.R. Procedures for Multiple Significant Trauma with MCC (DRG 957) and Cardiac Valve and Other Major Cardiothoracic Procedures without Cardiac Catheterization with MCC (DRG 219), together accounting for 27.6% of the total cost change, approximately $5.55 of PMPM change.
Malignant neoplasm with Surgery (Active Management) accounts for 40.2% of the total cost change.

drivers.title: Which Providers Are Driving It
description: The change is concentrated among:
- MAINEHEALTH MAINE MEDICAL CENTER PORTLAND: 37.0% contribution, $7.44 PMPM impact, increasing-cost (+24%).
- WILMA CHAN HIGHLAND HOSPITAL: 18.7% contribution, $3.76 PMPM impact, (new provider).

additional_signals: New member mix changed by +0.18 percentage points, from 3.1% to 3.3%.
NPAR/IDR activity is minimal and does not contribute meaningfully to the cost change.
